verdict.rationale: LegalZoom is a legal-services platform, so preparing board consents and collecting approvals is a fair axis, but the evidence never mentions board consents, resolutions, or online approval or e-signature collection. The closest items are AI-generated meeting minutes and a generic library of 150+ customizable documents, which are adjacent features rather than this capability.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can prepare board consents and resolutions and collect approvals online
